Strong industry partnerships accelerate hands-on learning opportunities, internships and co-ops. Become a Student Become a Partner Take your next giant leap in Indianapolis with the Indy Scholars scholarship program! Learn More Here Most Recognized Public University in the U.S. American Caldwell, 2025 in competitive,high-demand industries in leading and emergingSTEM fields New building broadens our impact We’re expanding Purdue’s urban footprint in Indianapolis with a new Academic Success Building. This cutting-edge facility, which will include classrooms, labs, dining and housing, will add to our growing presence in the heart of the city. Focused on innovative programs, this space will bring even more hands-on learning opportunities for our career-ready students. View the live construction webcam to see our progress. Learn More Explore Giving Opportunities Watch Video Building the future Our location expands Purdue’s mission and impact with a first-of-its-kind Hard-Tech Corridor, stretching between Indianapolis and West Lafayette. We’re building the future by linking industry to our world-class educators, researchers and students. Watch Video Learn More Fueling transformational growth, Purdue University’s expansion to Indianapolis will offer unique opportunities for Boilermaker students and faculty. We will expand enrollment. We will build startups. We will create new knowledge. We will connect talents and industry. We will maximize Indy’s unique strengths such as sports and biomedical technology. Purdue’s main campus now bookends the Hard Tech Corridor: 65 miles connecting Indy and West Lafayette. We will generate talents, jobs and innovation together in America’s heartland! Mung Chiang PresidentPurdue University Top News
